ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is approximately 95% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels with less than 5% high-intensity white pixels, primarily from water droplets and minor scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of large contiguous geometric blobs; pigmentation is a uniform dark field with stochastic, non-contiguous high-intensity point-source pixels across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a vertical pixel depth approximately 15-20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire boundary; specifically notable 'step' serrations on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white-textured clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with calcified surface growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, unaligned linear white streaks visible on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe, crossing diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular 'ragged' loss of material along the trailing edge of the right lobe compared to the left; heavy white textured scarring on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread high-intensity pixel noise across the ventral surface caused by water droplet reflection, creating a 'stardust' visual effect.
